reviews.title: Customizations Lacking
reviews.text:
I enjoy this app for its programs and easy “hit start and go” feeling! It makes it really easy to just get going with my workout. However, there are a few in-app functions that I wish it had: 
1) although you can swap exercises in a workout, there are limited options there for swapping. It would be great if you could choose from the entire library for these swaps!
2) once you start a workout, you can’t keep it going and go back to the home dashboard, or journal, or journey pages. This makes it hard to track any changes or feelings during the workout. 
3) similar to my previous point, I would love a “notes” section for each workout, or even with each exercise. I can’t make note of what I did differently or how it feels until I completely finish the workout and put it in a separate journal entry.
4) MANY of the traditional exercises do not have “learn” videos.

I hope some of these things can be adjusted soon! I enjoy the layout, theme, timers, learn videos that do exist, and would love to be able to customize my app experience with some of these things! I don’t want to go back to using a more generic app but I’m getting tired of not being able to change things if I need to during my workout.

reviews.title: 95% there!
reviews.text: I really like the Alive app. There are a ton of program options and each program is highly customizable. I love that I can see Whitney (it might not be Whitney in every program, idk yet) demo the movements. The only thing I’d recommend is finishing the “Learn” options for all movements. Maybe, if possible, have a human record the names of the warm-up and cool-down movements? Currently it’s a very robotic AI voice and it’s pretty hilarious to hear her say “Bent-knee pectineus/piriformis, RIGHT.” Pretty small potatoes, really. Other than that, this app is a great product and well worth the subscription price.

reviews.title: The best!
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app since it came out in like 2019 and I love it. Alive is continuously making improvements and seeing more programs. I love how streamlined everything is.

reviews.title: Love Whit
reviews.text: The app itself is very user friendly. My issue lies with the customer service and no-refund policy. Unfortunately, this tainted my view on the entirety of the app.

reviews.title: The use of it is very inconvenient
reviews.text:
So far it’s an easy app don’t get me wrong, what annoys me is the little inconveniences I get while using it, like I can’t tap on an exercise while the workout is in session because it will just start THAT even if it’s at the bottom, and when you go back to the exercise it resets the rest timer so you have to remember when and what you did. Also when it’s a rest day it says completed and then it resets your streak days. Like for example it’s my 4th day but I had a rest day on day 3 and after I finished day 4 the screen of “congratulations streak day 1” basically showed up. Which is very much annoying and not encouraging at all. 
This has to be fixed it’s simple!!

reviews.title: Beginner Friendly
reviews.text: Honest review from someone who is really eager to learn her way around the gym… BUY THE APP!!! The workouts are beginner friendly and hard to finish but challenging…. I’m sweating bullets as I write this lol! The only con I have is that she doesn’t talk at all… and if you have a phone your constantly having to look at your phone for the next movement especially if your not really familiar with the movements

reviews.title: The absolutely best for both advance and beginners
reviews.text: I’m a pretty advanced lifter and I just wanted to find something where didn’t have to do any mental work. This app is amazing. It has every feature you could ever need or want out of a workout app. I love that you can personalize it as much as you want or need by switching workouts and reps. It also allows you to switch what days you want to do which work out. If I could give it 100 stars I would. I tell everybody I know to download this app!

reviews.title: Best App
reviews.text: Whitney is amazing with what she and her team has done! So much attention to details! I love the details!🌸💗

reviews.title: Made a *habit* into a *lifestyle*
reviews.text: Not to be dramatic but this app changed everything about my confidence and excitement for the gym. It’s a game changer to not have to think about setting timers or writing your last weight in a note etc. it’s ALL IN ONE PLACE. And I love the aesthetics and I love the community and I love the format. I just love it.

reviews.title: Highly recommend for people new to the gym!
reviews.text: I’ve been wanting to get into the gym to make sure I’m keeping up with my health and I want to feel stronger. This app has given me less gym anxiety because it has the stretches, workouts, and cool downs all in one. And the count downs are great. I don’t feel lost in the gym and I’m beginning to be confident. Sometimes I have to stop and watch the videos a few times to ensure I have correct form which is very helpful. I recommend this app to everyone as it has workout for any level of fitness!

reviews.title: Kept charging me once it was cancelled
reviews.text: I love the Alive app I use it a lot back in 2024. But I cancelled my account in January and kept getting charged for months. They claim they can’t do any refunds which just seems like a money grab to me. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Good luck trying to cancel
reviews.text: Like the title says, they don’t care about you. They just care about their “policies” on their site and getting as much money as possible. Cancelled my membership right before the free trial ended and have now been charged two months in a row. Thankful for my CC company recognizing it as a scam. Beware!

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text: I love this app. I’ve been using it pretty consistently for two years and have noticed a change in my physique. I have lost weight, gained plenty of muscled, and I love the format. The only thing I would change is having a program that combined the strength and HIIT programs to get the benefits of both. I know you can do so separately, but having a designated program would make this even better

reviews.title: It wasn't for me
reviews.text: I had a very frustrating experience with the app. Contacting support was not helpful. Unfortunately, terms and conditions will trump customer satisfaction every time!

reviews.title: Game Changer
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for almost 2 years and I adore it. Build, Lift, and Legs Get It are my go to programs. The workout weight tracking is great for progressive overload and the warm/cool down are essential book ends for these straight forward but impactful workouts. I find the gifs on each exercise are usually enough for me and in cases when I’m not getting the move I’ll just search YouTube. Feedback: I recently started finishing my workout with cardio so I’d love a way to record cardio before the cool down. Also it’d be great to set default preferences for certain workouts so I don’t have to swap every time. I’d also love some longer, low impact mobility programs to do on non-lift days. I hope this app eventually finds good representatives for cardio (running, rowing, etc) and maybe even hyrox.

reviews.title: Nice app, some potential to be better
reviews.text: I like this app, been using it for years. I think it has a nice variety of programs. I wish ab/core workouts were included in full body workouts more. It seems to be a muscle group that gets neglected in nearly every program unless you select an ab workout to tack onto the end. Would be nice if I didn’t have to piecemeal workouts like that just to get core exercises. Would also love a program focused on cross training to improve running.

reviews.title: Love these workouts!
reviews.text: I have been following the 3 day essentials program for about a month now and it is so easy to follow, super user friendly and gives me a great workout every time!! Takes all the guess work out of going to the gym!

reviews.title: New Issues
reviews.text:
I have loved this app for a while however have been getting new issues popping up. Yesterday I did a full 45 minute push workout that was recorded. Logged on today for legs and it shows I didn’t do the prior workout. There’s also times where I will record my weights and reps but then the next set my reps have been wiped out. 

I would also love if there were a way to add in core workouts like they have the options for warm ups and cool downs.

reviews.title: Well Done
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app since the very beginning. I took a few months off for personal reasons, but now that I’m back, I’m blown away by how much it has improved.

The new rep tracker for each set is a total game changer. It’s incredibly helpful for advanced lifters who want detailed progress tracking, but it’s also a great tool for beginners learning how to monitor their weights and progression week after week.

Huge thank you to Whitney and the entire team for continuing to make the app better and better. Glad to be back👏🏼

reviews.title: Gets boring
reviews.text: I do like this app a lot and has been using it for years. But honestly I see no difference in coaches training styles. I get you have to stick with the same exercise in order to do progressive overload, but it does get super super boring after a while no mater which trainer you choose because they’ll have similar programs if not identical.

reviews.title: Love it, but wish learn vids were better
reviews.text: I really have enjoyed using this app and am almost done with the first program I’ve tried! I’ve seen a lot of progress and can’t wait to start another program. I only wish the learn videos for different exercises were more informative, including tips for what to think about to make sure you’re engaging the right muscles. Some of the videos just talk about the exercises without really talking about how to properly do it. Even seemingly simple exercises would be great to have videos for beginners

reviews.title: Live laugh love alive
reviews.text:
I love, love, love this app (especially the women centered part). It has made me feel more confident in the gym and I go in knowing what I’m working on. I struggle with making my own workouts and routine and this completely erased that worry. I love that there is a video showing how the exercise should look which is super helpful to perfect my form. 

The only thing I would love to see is recommended starting weights and recommended weight increases throughout the week. Sometimes I don’t know where to start or how much heavier I should lift and I think having those recommendations would be super helpful. Also possibly a compatibility with Garmin maybe?:)

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text: I absolutely love this app, it is super easy to use and completely customizable. The best feature it has, which I haven’t seen before, is being able to listen to music AND the workout without it pausing or quieting my music! I wouldn’t say it is too expensive but for others it may be, for me it is worth it, it helps me not look crazy in the gym as well as perfect home workouts to complete on your own time.

reviews.title: Excellent but missing a few things
reviews.text: I am loving every second of this app. It feels so great to train with it, exercises have their own mini videos for you to follow through and make sure you are doing them correctly. The warm up and cool downs are also so helpful to avoid injury and truly make me feel like I have a physical trainer with me for my lifts. But I do wish there was a calendar where I could track cardio as well or follow cardio workouts, and I’d love to not have a robotic voice dictating the name of the exercises. Maybe we can get the trainers to call out the exercises and maybe talk to you throughout the movement to remind you to lock in certain things etc. because I put my phone aside to complete the exercise, so having that in my ear would be super helpful. Other than that, I’m loving it and been training with it every day for the past 3 weeks. Life changing

reviews.title: Pregnant mamas
reviews.text: I did the pregnancy program throughout my entire first pregnancy, with my second I only did a couple of weeks because when you put your due date in, it sets up your workout according to your due date and that’s the only thing I do not like. I want to start my week of workouts on Monday or Tuesday so getting the option to choose start day of the week would make this program PERFECT. I’d come back for that!

reviews.text: I love the app and the workouts but for some reason after having it for a few days, it now keeps crashing before fully loading. I’m starting to go insane.

reviews.title: Very Basic
reviews.text: Simple and efficient interface. Workouts however are very basic and not fitting for someone experienced. No variation in workouts. No actual coaching. Wish I could get a refund

reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: I LOVE that the weight tracker is right on the screen for the workout now! I love being able to easily see my history quickly to adjust my weight if needed. I love the new look of the screen as well and the capabilities the app has now (ie. the timer adjustment and more). I would love to see in the future a section on the app that has all workouts split into each working body group or what area they hit and be able to scroll through that to see all the workouts. All in all, I love using Alive!

reviews.title: overall in love with it
reviews.text: this is a great app for working out i’ve tired a bunch of different kinds and even tried logging my own stuff on notes app but this one is definitely the best. only reason im giving it a four is because there are still some tweaks to be fixed. like how it’ll lower my music in the background and i can’t get it back up if i have the voice cues on. sometimes it doesn’t do that but sometimes it does and it is pretty bothersome to sit there in the middle of my workout to try to fix it. it would be nice if the app didn’t affect my music volume. sometimes the voice cues will lower it so you can hear it talk and then it goes back up which is fine but other times it keeps my music low the whole time. another thing is how long the rest times are in between… three minutes for a rest time is so long i always push it up to better shorter time but it would be nice not having to do that everything single time. also live the feature where i can swap an exercise that tailors best to me but sometimes that wont change the sets or if it’s something that involves both sides and it doesn’t alter to that. (hope that makes kind of sense)

reviews.title: My music stops 😕
reviews.text: I have been using this app well over a year now, but with the recent update my music gets paused every time I swipe out of the app, the timer ends to go to the next workout, or i swipe down to see my full workout for the day. It's so annoying when you're mid set and then your music stops out of nowhere. I love the app otherwise, but please fix this!!!

reviews.title: Dislike the new update
reviews.text: I want to love that app and I had been until today. I am on week 9 of a program, the conventional deadlift where you have to increase the weight each set. Why is it not letting me input the new weight for each set? It’s only logging one weight across the board. How am I supposed to know how much weight increased I did next time if it’s only going to show 1?

reviews.title: New update is good - but music stops when I open the app
reviews.text: Love the new update and abilities to track reps. I haven’t had this issue until this update, but now every time I open the app my music will stop playing. It’s quite inconvenient - hopefully a quick fix because I love this app!

reviews.title: Great workouts not great UX
reviews.text: Hard to reorder the trainings and the  intervals could be changeable. But workouts and videos are great

reviews.title: My favorite training app EVER!
reviews.text: This app is worth every penny. I’ve used a few fitness apps in the past but this one takes the cake. It’s aesthetically cute, yes. BUT there’s no fluff. It’s the workouts and you can see the workout as you’re doing it. There are timers, rest periods, alternate exercises you can swap out. You can choose your trainer and a program. Not feeling a program? They have a whole section of workouts for whatever vibe you’re feeling for the day with stretching and mindful mobility included (something I always avoided in the past!) I have nothing but wonderful things to say about this app. It is truly customizable. I LOVE it please don’t change a thing!

reviews.title: Love this app BUT
reviews.text:
I love this app and absolutely recommend it to everyone, but the only thing that frustrates me more than anything is sometimes I accidentally swipe out of my workout or I forget to save it when I end it, OR my WiFi connection is poor and it doesn’t save my workout. So, my stats and calendar tracking are off, which annoys me to no end. I wish that there was an autosave feature instead of a prompt to save your workout, this way if you accidentally swipe out during a set or if you forget to manually save your workout, it’s automatically saved for you.

One other improvement that would be awesome would be having an offline feature. I went on a cruise last summer and didn’t have WiFi. None of my progress was saved during that trip and I feel like I also remember having an issue with certain things loading.

reviews.title: BEST WORKOUT FOR WOMEN!!
reviews.text: Title says it all! I love it so much especially the ignite program by Jessica Bickling! 🙌🏻

reviews.text: This app freaking suck so much literally it says that you don’t have to pay it only says you have to pay for premium so when I downloaded it I was so excited to finally get a work out app for free then I hit in a signed up and then I tried to start a work out and it didn’t let me access any workouts and then I tried to like find a free one there one no free ones and when I tried anything else and like the journal or the other stuff it said you have to become a premium member and pay either a $114 thing each year or $14.99 a month all in all this app sucks

reviews.title: obsessed!!!!
reviews.text:
this app literally got me into the gym as a senior in college for the first time since my first year of high school! i was so nervous about starting and used the begin again challenge to jump right in. i loved the in app weight tracking, compatibility with my apple watch, and ability to swap out exercises or reorder the program to be shy girl friendly. 
now being about a year into my fitness journey, i’m still obsessed! i love to pick and choose from the daily workouts provided, or even just use them as inspiration. i genuinely fall asleep picking out what i’m going to do the next day because i’m so excited sometimes. 
the only thing i wish was the ability to create your own program. i would love to continue using this app for all my tracking as i continue to progress and grow with it. 
regardless, watching whitney gave me so much confidence and this app was genuinely life changing for me. so grateful and forever glad to be ALIVE!

reviews.title: So many options
reviews.text: I Love this app it's got everything, workout options, home, gym, so many great trainers, a timer and everything is tracked. The only thing I wish the weight on the tracker stays with THAT set instead of updating for every set. But other than that it's PERFECT

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Looove the alive app ! So great and user friendly. Would love to see more dumbbell only and 3 day programs in the future

reviews.title: nutrition
reviews.text: I absolutely love this app. I just wish it included healthy meal ideas bc I’m running out of ideas 😅

reviews.title: I love Alive
reviews.text: Alive is the best. The sculpt workouts are such a great add. I love doing them combined with one of the strength workouts.

reviews.title: Functionally buggy, but still good
reviews.text: I’m a fan of the workouts and a lot of features of the app (the soft countdown timer, the clear videos, etc) but I’m finding that it’s functionally buggy. I can’t save the reps I actually did for an exercise or leave myself notes (like, “add more weight next time”). So if I do more reps because the weight was too light I’m prone to repeat the easier workout because there’s no way for me to keep tabs of how it went the last time I did the exercise.
